P is complete occupation dephasing, Q=I-P, S_Q>=dI. Artificial complete occupation measurements at numerical rate r add rQ to B while preserving populations. On K=ker(PA|Q), projection Pi gives C=Pi(S_Q+QAQ)Pi and j=Pi J. The exact source identity f_n(r)=<j,(C+rI)^-1 j>/n extends to Re z>-d with |f_n(z)|<=a/(d+Re z), a=t^2/2. C and Pi are proof devices, never acquired huge matrices. Constraints precede the shift; an ordinary identity regularizer would also damp slow populations. Rational nodes r_j=d(1+j/m)/8, j=0..m, have interpolation bias<=4a/d*2^-(m+1), total weight W_m<= (4e)^m, and required node error delta=epsilon/(4W_m). Logarithmic m gives polynomial amplification; arbitrary fitted extrapolation has no such guarantee.

A self-contained adjacent-swap comparison yields population coercivity sigma=tmin/(2n^2) and a conservative full inverse norm Rcal=O(n^6), without a supplied many-body gap. Ordinary Laplace regularization lambda then incurs bias<=a lambda Rcal^2. At an Exp(lambda) stopping time, random input/output bonds and sign, a preparable local current eigenstate mixture and bounded output Y give estimator Z=n t^2 sY/lambda. All tracial particle-number sectors contribute. The numerical unraveling uses local Z kicks plus global occupation measurements; each measurement samples the correlated occupation configuration and restarts from that product state. Time/event/long-coherence caps return zero without renormalizing accepted samples, with charged bounded-payoff bias.

Retained coherent intervals are O(log n+log delta^-1) long. Established constructive 1D locality gives logarithmic block lengths and polynomial MPS/contraction work on each restarted interval. The source charges block arithmetic, random schedules, absolute Born-probability errors and rational unitary approximants; it does not assume a compact unknown witness or divide by minimum branch probabilities. This combined finite-bit algorithm remains an unaudited mathematical derivation. Small full-system diagnostic scripts do not implement the production locality-based simulator.

An exact four-site population Schur complement after eliminating full interacting coherences has off-diagonal entry115904/10076409>0, invalidating that classical-rate interpretation. This does not refute N747's bare-dissipative exclusion correction or all classical algorithms. Floating n=5,6,7 order-eight reconstructions differ from direct solves by about3e-8 to8e-9, while the proven D_n bias bound is .0078125 and weight sum2228225. The 16000-trajectory assay is synthetic, not a laboratory result. At n=8 and kappa tolerance .01, a sufficient conservative recipe exceeds1e74 samples per node. It was not executed; it is not a lower bound or practical advantage.

N747's literal G1 asks for explicit rational balanced witnesses; this scalar algorithm does not prove that output theorem. Its macroscopic D theorem also supplies no usable |D_n-D| rate. T1 must acquire constructive uniform constants or a different controlled limit procedure. Gaussian hydrodynamics, finite temperature and physical coefficient/model calibration remain separate. No Gibbs specimens, quantum hardware or physical global measurement apparatus are required by the classical proposal; all numerical operations and supplied-model acquisition still cost resources. Independent correctness, historical priority, practical advantage and transformative prediction remain unestablished.
